rubric.role_summary: Senior-to-staff product manager for software product development, leading products from conception through rollout and coordinating product, engineering, design, sales, and marketing.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior-to-staff product manager for software product development, leading products from conception through rollout and coordinating product, engineering, design, sales, and marketing.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Senior-to-staff-level product management seniority.
- 6+ years of experience in the software industry.
- Previous experience in engineering and/or design roles.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): North America time zones; Europe time zones. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
